instruction: Navigate to the page where you can request a copy of your driving record.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from Virginia DMV homepage to the driving record transcript request page. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric to verify correct URL navigation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the single requirement: navigating to the driving record request page
Getter logic (active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the active tab URL from Chrome accessibility tree
Metric function (is_expected_active_tab) correctly receives the rules dictionary and compares URLs using compare_urls()
Expected URL (https://www.dmv.virginia.gov/drivers/transcript) is semantically correct for the instruction
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL -> metric compares with expected URL -> returns 1.0 if match
Metric parameter handling is correct: uses 'rule' parameter name and directly accesses rule['type'] and rule['url'] without incorrect .get('rules') pattern
Complete coverage: instruction has one navigation requirement, evaluator checks that one requirement
